children: NexMetals reported 7.55 metres grading 6.48% CuEq in SMD-26-219 and a visual intercept in SMD-26-217 that extends the High-Grade Trend to ~1.5 km.
SMD-26-219: 7.55 m grading 6.48% CuEq (2.70% Cu, 1.83% Ni) within a 13.50 m Lower Zone intercept, confirming thick high-grade massive sulphide.
SMD-26-217: visual intercept across three mineralized zones totaling 38.65 m, including a newly discovered Third Zone with 4.30 m of massive sulphide; assays pending.
High-Grade Trend extended ~100 m toward Selebi North, now defined over ~1.5 km, supported by BHEM indicating continuity beyond SMD-26-217.
Results bolster expectation of resource growth beyond the 2024 MRE and support inclusion of post-cutoff drilling in ongoing exploration for the 2026 MRE.
Company engaged TECT to build an integrated 3D geological model to improve targeting and assess further expansion potential.
